files.description: Read when the diff touches README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, or CLAUDE.md — which doc owns which content, and what a doc change must update alongside it.
Read when the diff adds, moves, removes, or pins a dependency in package.json or ui/package.json.
Read when the diff touches rumdl's version or any of its configs and invocations — .rumdl.toml, hk.pkl, mise.toml.
Read when the diff touches the top-level opencode/ plugin directory.
